description: Routing test (stage 1): which skill Claude Code invokes for natural requests when the custom incident and review skills compete with engineering:incident-response, engineering:code-review and the built-in code-review. Labels were written before any run. 'acceptable' lists every pick that serves the request ('none' = no skill); 'intended' is the custom skill the request was written for. Kinds: custom (written for a custom skill), eng-fair (contains an engineering skill's trigger phrase), ambiguous, negative (none of the competing skills should fire).

prompts.prompt: We have an incident. Since about 14:05 Lisbon time the checkout API is returning 5xx: Grafana shows ~12% of POST /api/checkout failing on edge-01 and edge-02 (window 14:05-14:20, still ongoing). checkout-svc v2.31 was deployed at 13:58. The payments provider status page is green. Rui is on call and is checking the DB pool graphs; Marta (DBA) says DB CPU is at 30%. No customer comms have gone out yet. Write the live incident report and a short email to the leadership team in Portuguese (they're in Lisbon). I'm Gabriel, the incident lead.
prompts.note: iteration-7 eval 0; two artifacts, so the coordinator; 'we have an incident' is also an engineering trigger

prompts.prompt: prod is down. login returns 502 for everyone since 09:40, pagerduty is going off, nothing deployed today as far as I know. what do we do first?
Alert just fired: orders-api p99 went from 300ms to 4s at 16:12 and the error rate is about 3%. Is this an incident? How bad?
prompts.note: severity assessment of an alert

prompts.prompt: where are we on the checkout incident and what's next? so far: 14:05 5xx start on edge-01/02, 14:20 Rui ruled out the DB pool (CPU 30%), 14:31 we decided to roll back checkout-svc v2.31, rollback is running now.

Start an incident report for the payment confirmation failures. What we have: since ~10:12 about 8% of payment confirmations time out at payments-gw, fraud-svc latency is up, the orders DB failed over at 10:05 but Marta says it completed cleanly. Nothing ruled out yet.
Give me a short status update I can post in #inc-checkout: rollback of checkout-svc to v2.30 finished at 14:41, 5xx down from 12% to 2%, edge-02 still a bit elevated, next update 15:15.
prompts.note: 'status update mid-incident' is an engineering trigger

prompts.prompt: Update the incident doc in inputs/inc-live.md: Rui confirmed the DB pool is fine, we're now looking at the fraud-svc timeout config that changed on Monday.

Checkout was failing on 30 Sep for ~40 minutes around lunchtime. The evidence is in inputs/: the HAProxy log from edge-01, a Grafana export, the change log and the on-call notes. Find the root cause and tell me how confident we can be. Ana thinks it was the CDN cert rotation.

Tiago is sure it was the reco v3.4 deploy. What was the root cause, how sure are we, and what fixed it?

prompts.prompt: Bruno wrote the RCA for INC-2219 (inputs/inc-2219/rca-bruno.md). He says the DB failover caused it. Does that hold up against what we have in that folder?
prompts.note: check whether an existing RCA holds up

prompts.prompt: We get bursts of 504s from the API gateway most nights around 02:00, for a week now, and nothing is deployed in that window. Timings: Mon 02:01-02:07, Tue 02:00-02:09, Thu 02:02-02:05. The DB backup job and log rotation both run at 02:00. What's causing it?
prompts.note: recurring failure; engineering:debug fits 'behavior diverges, cause not obvious'

prompts.prompt: INC-2219 is resolved. Write the postmortem. Everything is in inputs/inc-2219/: the incident record (with our SLO), the RCA summary and the Slack notes; the change log is inputs/changes.md. It goes to engineering and leadership for review.
prompts.note: iteration-5 postmortem; 'blameless postmortem after resolution' is an engineering trigger

prompts.prompt: The checkout outage from Tuesday is over and the fix is deployed. I need the blameless write-up for Friday's review. Timeline: 14:05 errors start, 14:12 alert, 14:20 DB ruled out, 14:31 rollback decided, 14:41 rollback done, 14:55 errors back to baseline. Trigger was checkout-svc v2.31 shipping a DB connection pool of 5.

Turn these RCA notes into an email for the platform and payments teams: root cause was the fraud-svc client timeout dropped from 2s to 500ms in Monday's config change; payments-gw retried and saturated its pool; fixed by reverting the config at 11:02. Owners: platform for a config guardrail, payments for a retry budget.

Escreve um email para a direção a explicar o incidente de ontem no checkout: 40 minutos de falhas (14:05-14:45), cerca de 12% dos pagamentos falharam, a causa foi o deploy da v2.31 com o pool de ligações mal configurado, já revertido. Próximos passos: validação de configuração no pipeline.
prompts.note: PT-PT
